purpose: Confirm the deployed build really calls the organiser Claude Sonnet 4.5 JSON API, not the offline keyword rules.
method: Created a throwaway project through the public site (HDB 4-room, no saved inspiration).
Added one homeowner note written so that no decision option appears as a literal keyword, which the offline rules can only ignore.
Ran POST /api/projects/{id}/analysis-runs with no mode override, i.e. one real gateway request.
Read back GET /api/projects/{id}/analysis-runs for the recorded usage row.
note: Whenever we visit friends' places I find myself drawn to rooms where the late afternoon light lands on something with a bit of grain to it, and where you can put a mug down without thinking twice. The last condo showflat we saw felt like a hotel lobby - everything reflective, nothing you'd want to sit on for three hours with a laptop. We host my parents most Sundays, so seven or eight people end up in the living room, and the TV is honestly secondary to that.

proposals.evidence: Explicitly drawn to "late afternoon light" as a positive quality in visited spaces
Attracted to surfaces "with a bit of grain to it" where light lands; disliked reflective finishes in contrasting example
Hosts parents most Sundays with seven to eight people in living room; TV is secondary to gathering
Regular Sunday hosting of seven to eight people; living room serves as primary gathering space
Values ability to "sit on for three hours with a laptop" and put a mug down comfortably; rejects formal hotel-lobby feel

conclusions: The note contains none of the proposed option labels, so these five observations could not come from the offline keyword rules.
Every observation arrived as status 'proposed' with a quoted source span; nothing was auto-confirmed.
One request was consumed; the run is recorded in the analysis-runs ledger with model, prompt version and token counts.
Image analysis stayed disabled, matching the documented limitation.
